request: Build a small headless Jac research-paper library. A researcher can save a paper with title, author, personal summary, source URL and tags; each saved paper receives a generated ID and timestamp. They can list saved papers, find papers by tag, and retrieve one paper by ID. Store Paper as a graph node in model.jac, and expose the operations from main.jac. Include tests for saving, listing, tag filtering and ID lookup.
acceptance: Saving a paper reports its metadata, generated ID and timestamp and attaches the Paper node to root.
Listing reports every saved Paper and searching by a tag excludes unrelated papers.
Looking up a saved Paper by ID returns it; an unknown ID returns None.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a backend-only service; no JSX, browser UI or external AI.
Use the source's public walker names save_paper, list_papers, search_papers_by_tag and public function get_paper_details.
